claim_summaries: The archive lower bound's uniform-TV to posterior-regret step and its total hybrid-dimension accounting are sound under a single encoder and decoder independent of the unknown parameter, independent shared seeds, and a per-seed dimension cap.
The interface should explicitly state decoder-independence from the unknown parameter; without it, a D=1 decoder that receives v samples P_v exactly.

Uniform worst-case TV supports each binary coordinate prior used in the product lower. One prior-averaged TV criterion cannot replace it; an exact two-state example has average TV 1/400 and worst-case TV 1/4 at D=1.

Periodic and graded positive-hat codec normalizations are consistent; exact finite checks passed. No transfer from the summary-only N75 Poincare plateau to additive mutual-information control is established.
